description: Travel times on road segments (historical) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. In order to collect data on the state of traffic, the City of Montreal is deploying a network of sensors using Bluetooth technology on certain strategic road segments and making it possible to calculate the travel time on these segments. This data set shows travel times. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Congestion, PolearTM, Route, SUM, Travel time. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
